summary: Of 12 detected events: 3 confirmed by same-region/same-window external products (457f3f87 US Southern Plains heat dome - NWS warnings + press; e7fa2290 E Africa abnormal heat 24-30 Sep - FEWS NET/CPC hazard product with explicit p90-based abnormal-heat flag; bdb9bb08 Afar/Red Sea Aug 11-19 - ICPAC 'Danger'-category heat-stress outlooks), 8 corroborated only as regional/seasonal context (the persistent FEWS NET/CPC 'abnormal heat' regime over the Sahel/East Africa and the INMET-documented hot, El Nino-dry Amazon in Aug-Oct 2026; most Amazon and Sahel events lack any specific press event report because daily-mean 2m ~33C heat there is rarely reported as a discrete event), and 1 (Greenland freeze 88bb73d7) has no external corroboration at all - no bulletin or news item mentions a cold outbreak 16-21 Oct 2026; note that ~-40C daily means are climatologically near-normal over the high-elevation north-greenland ice sheet in October, so the raw value is not obviously extreme and relative-anomaly evidence should be the bar. Notable reported extremes missing from the event set: East Asia's record early-August heatwave (window start may explain), Western Europe's record summer including August heatwaves +3-5C (genuine detector gap - inside window), Brazil's late-September 43.3C national-record heatwave with INMET red heatwave alert (genuine detector gap), southern-Brazil September frosts, northern-Australia early-November 45-47C heatwave (late-window truncation), record Oct warmth in Korea/Japan and the US (sub-threshold durations), and Korea's late-October Arctic cold outbreak (absolute-threshold freeze detector is blind to relative cold snaps).
